system.description:
A box, bag, or other storage case containing an assortment of precise tools for performing maintenance and repairs on devices. Versions exist at various tech levels, with different kinds of tools at each: a Tech Level 1 kit may consist of wrenches, screwdrivers, pliers, and similar items, while a Tech Level 3 kit may contain precision devices suitable for working on microelectronics.

A toolkit allows a character to repair a damaged piece of technology. A toolkit can repair technology with a Tech Level 1 higher than that of the toolkit. Tech Level 3 are powered and recharge after a Break rest.
